components.name: Button
components.description: Paper button with an ink border that inverts when pressed and is hatched when disabled.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Cut line</button> <button class="ds-btn" disabled>Air tanker: 0 left</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid #1c2120; border-radius: 3px; background: #f6f7f2; color: #1c2120; font: 600 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .1s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fff; } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { background: #1c2120; color: #f6f7f2; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2521c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { color: #858b86; border-color: #c9cdc3; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28,33,32,.09) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px); cursor: default; }

components.name: Go Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-go { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #c2410c; color: #fff; font: 600 16px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-go:hover { background: #b03a0a; } .ds-go:active { background: #8f2f08; } .ds-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2521c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Crew Row
components.description: A crew in the deck with its live status; the selected one rings its marker in orange.
components.css: .ds-crew { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 5px 12px; min-height: 46px; width: 280px; text-align: left; border: 0; background: #f6f7f2; font: 14px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c2120; } .ds-crew.sel { background: #fff; } .ds-crew .mk { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1c2120; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-crew.sel .mk { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #e2521c; } .ds-crew small { color: #545b57; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Grade Stamp
components.css: .ds-stamp { width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #e2521c; color: #e2521c; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 54px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transform: rotate(-8deg); background: #f6f7f2; }

narrative.overview: Fire Season is played on a survey-style contour map where every order and every state is drawn as map symbology. The fire carries the drama; the interface stays paper and ink.
keyCharacteristics: Contour map with fuel tints and symbols
One signal orange for fire and action
Radio line reports in plain sentences

rules.name: Orange is fire
rules.body: Signal orange marks fire, selection and the primary action, never decoration.

rules.name: Pink is air
rules.body: Retardant pink appears only where a tanker dropped.

rules.name: Paper has no shadows
rules.body: Depth comes from ink borders, never shadows or glows.

dos: Keep the fire the only saturated area
Report events on the radio line
